QuestInfo.0: Talk to Jett again to get the finished message.
QuestInfo.1: Jett's message is for her #bfriends#k.You can sense the deep bond they share in her expression as she hands you the message. Jett said to #btalk to her when you're ready#k, and she will send you to the spaceship.
